action: Call 1930 immediately if money was taken. A state police operator notes the details and registers a ticket.
You receive an SMS with an acknowledgement number. Submit the full details on cybercrime.gov.in within 24 hours using that number.
Contact the bank, card provider, wallet or UPI app as well.
Keep ready: your name, mobile number, nearest police station, district, bank name, amount, account or UPI ID debited, transaction IDs, and a short description of what happened.
